responsibility: Specializes GNU-user OS builtins and dynamic-linker selection for kOpenSolaris-based GNU systems. It defines __OpenSolaris_kernel__ and __GLIBC__, asserts unix/posix semantics, and overrides GNU_USER_DYNAMIC_LINKER with the Solaris ld.so.1 path. This header adapts the generic GNU-user configuration to a GNU userspace running over an OpenSolaris kernel.
